reviewItem.question: Does "Other Changes: There are many other PRs which were merged in this release cycle and we'd encourage you to read the release notes below" mean a change to protocol-behavior:cert-manager|name=log-line-format (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 adds more structured logging information to certain log lines, so some log lines have changed format, which may affect operators who filter logs with grep or similar tools.
